type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface Walkthrough { readonly camera: FreeCamera; jumpTo(eye: Vec, target: Vec): void; dispose(): void }

function cloneVec(v: Vec): Vec { return { x: v.x, y: v.y, z: v.z }; }

function setVec(dest: unknown, src: Vec): void {
  const obj = dest as { x?: number; y?: number; z?: number; set?: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => void; copy?: (src: Vec) => void };
  if (typeof obj.set === "function") {
    obj.set(src.x, src.y, src.z);
  } else if (typeof obj.copy === "function") {
    obj.copy(src);
  } else {
    obj.x = src.x;
    obj.y = src.y;
    obj.z = src.z;
  }
}

function isValidNumber(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
}

function computeYawPitch(eye: Vec, target: Vec): { yaw: number; pitch: number } {
  const dx = target.x - eye.x;
  const dy = target.y - eye.y;
  const dz = target.z - eye.z;
  const horizontal = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (horizontal < 1e-12 && Math.abs(dy) < 1e-12) {
    return { yaw: 0, pitch: 0 };
  }
  return { yaw: Math.atan2(dx, dz), pitch: Math.atan2(dy, horizontal) };
}

function getOrientationForView(eye: Vec, target: Vec): { yaw: number; pitch: number } {
  try {
    const scratch = createFreeCamera(cloneVec(eye), cloneVec(target));
    if (isValidNumber(scratch._yaw) && isValidNumber(scratch._pitch)) {
      return { yaw: scratch._yaw, pitch: scratch._pitch };
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
  return computeYawPitch(eye, target);
}

export function createWalkthrough(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, scene: SceneContext, eye: Vec, target: Vec): Walkthrough {
  const initialEye = cloneVec(eye);
  const initialTarget = cloneVec(target);
  const camera = createFreeCamera(initialEye, initialTarget);
  scene.camera = camera;
  let detachControls = attachFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene);
  let disposed = false;

    const eye = cloneVec(newEye);
    const target = cloneVec(newTarget);
    setVec(camera.position, eye);
    setVec(camera.target, target);
    const orientation = getOrientationForView(eye, target);
    camera._yaw = orientation.yaw;
    camera._pitch = orientation.pitch;
  };

  const dispose = (): void => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    detachControls();
    detachControls = () => {};
  };

  return { camera, jumpTo, dispose };
}
